test_title: PYST 26: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 3 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

The disabled should not be oppressed.

options.text: Let not the disabled be oppressed.
The disabled have not been oppressed
We should not be oppressing the disabled

solution:
The correct answer is **Do not oppress the disabled.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• Given sentence **"****The disabled should not be oppressed"** is in **Simple Present Tense **and in **Passive voice**.
 
• The rule for changing a simple Present Indefinite tense form into an Active voice is as follows:
 
 
• ​Interchange the subject with the object and vice-versa. 
 
• While converting the negative sentences with should into an active voice, the subject starts with Do not. 
 
• Convert the verb "Disable" into a past participle or 3rd form of the verb.
 
• "Should not" will change into "Do not."
 
• Structure: **Subject + first form of verb + Object.**
 
 
 
• **Example: ***The car should not be moved.* *(Active Voice)*

 *Do not move the car. (Passive Voice)*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Active voice** is used when the subject of the sentence does the action.
 
• The **P****assive voice** is used when we focus on the object of the sentence.
